program:
app "Budget" wallet plum
table spend what text, amount money, category pick Food|Bills|Travel|Fun|Health
setting budget money = 80000 "Monthly budget"
state m date = today
state cat text = ""
let spent = sum(spend.amount month of m)
monthnav m
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
"Safe to spend" round((budget - spent) / (monthdays(m) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day. Last month:" sum(spend.amount prev month) faint
draw 100, 50
  line 0, 50, 100, 0 stroke edge
  poly stroke accent thick 2
    each days month of m
      pt 100 * monthday(it) / monthdays(m), 50 - 50 * clamp(sum(spend.amount month of m where at <= it) / budget, 0, 1)
each spend month of m by category
  stack tap set cat = if(cat = it.key, "", it.key)
    row
      it.key grow
      sum(it.amount) bold
    draw 100, 3
      rect 0, 0, 100 * sum(it.amount) / spent, 3 fill if(cat = it.key, accent, muted)
form spend
list spend month of m where cat = "" or category = cat by day
describe:
Budget, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- spend: what: text; amount: money; category: one of Food, Bills, Travel, Fun, Health. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 80000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of spend in the month of m.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today; cat, starting at "".
Shows:
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
- spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
- text: "Safe to spend", the result of budget minus spent divided by the result of the number of days in the month of m minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day. Last month:", the total amount of spend last month.
- a drawing made of lines, a line through points.
- for each group of spend entries in the month of m by category:
  - a group; a tap sets cat to "" when cat is its key, otherwise its key:
    - text: its key.
    - text: the total amount of the group.
    - a drawing made of rectangles.
- a form to add a spend.
- a list of spend in the month of m where cat is "" or category is cat by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: a sentence then a list of what is wanted, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the most unusual feature

program:
app "Milk shop" milk ocean
table customer name text, rate money "Rate per litre", note text?
table delivery customer ref customer, litres num 0..
table payment customer ref customer, amount money
state m date = today
monthnav m
count(customer) "customers," sum(delivery today, it.litres) "litres delivered today" head
each customer as c
  let bill = sum(c.delivery month of m, it.litres) * c.rate
  stack card gap 1
    row
      c.name bold grow
      "Bill" bill bold
    "Paid" sum(c.payment.amount month of m) ", left" bill - sum(c.payment.amount month of m) faint
    row gap 1
      each [0.5, 1, 2] as v
        button v "L" tap add delivery customer = c, litres = v
form customer, "Add customer"
form payment, "Payment received"
list delivery month of m by day
describe:
Milk shop, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- customer: name: text; "Rate per litre": money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- delivery: customer: a customer; litres: number, at least 0. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- payment: customer: a customer; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.
Shows:
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- text: how many customer entries, "customers,", the sum of its litres over the delivery today, "litres delivered today".
- for each customer:
  - text: the name of the customer.
  - text: "Bill", bill.
  - text: "Paid", the total amount of the customer's payment entries in the month of m, ", left", bill minus the total amount of the customer's payment entries in the month of m.
  - for 0.5, 1, 2:
    - a button the value, "L"; a tap adds a delivery with customer set to the customer, litres set to the value.
- a form to add a customer.
- a form to add a payment.
- a list of delivery in the month of m by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: mention the last feature first
